name: Fragment of Harmonic Whimsy
description:
After the character to which this is attached uses a Skill: All your characters gain 1 stack of Bond of Life, and you consume 1 fewer Elemental Dice the next time your character uses a Skill. (Once per Round)
(A character can equip a maximum of 1 Artifact)
